```{r cluster-players}
extract_coefs_long <- function(model, pid) {
  cm <- coef(model)
  if (is.null(dim(cm))) {
    message("Person ", pid, ": exactly two action levels in this person's ",
            "data, which changes coef()'s output shape -- skipping in clustering.")
    return(NULL)
  }
  as.data.frame(cm) %>%
    tibble::as_tibble() %>%
    mutate(outcome_level = rownames(cm), person_id = pid) %>%
    pivot_longer(-c(outcome_level, person_id), names_to = "feature", values_to = "weight")
}


# --- "behavior" basis: what each person's model predicts in the SAME set of situations ---
# Per-person weights are noisy and partly interchangeable (many weight combinations give
# nearly the same behavior), so clustering them mostly clusters noise. Instead, pick a
# fixed set of representative situations from the pooled data (real rows, spread over the
# observed range of the predictors), ask every person's model for its choice probabilities
# in each, and cluster those probability profiles. People are grouped when they would act
# alike in the same circumstances.
build_probes <- function(data, cols, n_probe) {
  d <- data[complete.cases(data[, cols, drop = FALSE]), , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(d) > 4000) { set.seed(1); d <- d[sample(nrow(d), 4000), , drop = FALSE] }
  num_cols <- cols[map_lgl(cols, ~ is.numeric(d[[.x]]) || is.logical(d[[.x]]))]
  num_cols <- num_cols[map_lgl(num_cols, ~ n_distinct(d[[.x]]) > 1)]
  if (length(num_cols) == 0 || nrow(d) <= n_probe) { set.seed(1); return(d[sample(nrow(d), min(n_probe, nrow(d))), , drop = FALSE]) }
  M <- scale(sapply(num_cols, function(v) as.numeric(d[[v]])))
  M[is.na(M)] <- 0
  k <- min(n_probe, nrow(unique(as.data.frame(M))) - 1)
  set.seed(1); km <- kmeans(M, centers = k, nstart = 3)
  idx <- vapply(seq_len(k), function(j) which.min(rowSums((M - matrix(km$centers[j, ], nrow(M), ncol(M), byrow = TRUE))^2)), integer(1))
  d[unique(idx), , drop = FALSE]
}

fingerprint_one <- function(m, probes, action_levels) {
  nd <- as.data.frame(probes)
  for (cn in names(m$xlevels)) {   # a factor level this person never met is replaced by one their model knows
    cur <- as.character(nd[[cn]])
    nd[[cn]] <- factor(ifelse(cur %in% m$xlevels[[cn]], cur, m$xlevels[[cn]][1]), levels = m$xlevels[[cn]])
  }
  pr <- predict(m, newdata = nd, type = "probs")
  if (is.null(dim(pr))) { pr <- cbind(1 - pr, pr); colnames(pr) <- m$lev }
  out <- matrix(0, nrow(nd), length(action_levels), dimnames = list(NULL, action_levels))
  out[, colnames(pr)] <- pr
  as.vector(out)
}


# Standardise a block of columns and give the block unit total variance, so blocks can be combined fairly.
blk <- function(M) {
  M <- M[, apply(M, 2, function(z) !anyNA(z) && sd(z) > 1e-8), drop = FALSE]
  if (ncol(M) == 0) return(NULL)
  scale(M) / sqrt(ncol(M))
}

# Split people into classes. Start with everyone; find the best split into 2-kmax groups (mean
# silhouette) among those with no tiny group; keep it if it is good enough; then look inside any
# class that still holds more than max_share of everyone and try again.
recursive_classes <- function(X, min_sil, max_share, kmax, min_size) {
  N <- nrow(X); lab <- rep(1L, N); next_id <- 2L; todo <- list(seq_len(N)); sils <- numeric(0)
  while (length(todo) > 0) {
    idx <- todo[[length(todo)]]; todo[[length(todo)]] <- NULL
    if (length(idx) <= max_share * N || length(idx) < 2 * min_size + 1) next
    Xi <- X[idx, , drop = FALSE]; dm <- dist(Xi); best <- NULL
    for (kk in 2:min(kmax, length(idx) - 1)) {
      cand <- tryCatch({ set.seed(1); kmeans(Xi, centers = kk, nstart = 20) }, error = function(e) NULL)
      if (is.null(cand) || min(cand$size) < min_size) next
      sil <- mean(cluster::silhouette(cand$cluster, dm)[, "sil_width"])
      if (is.null(best) || sil > best$sil) best <- list(km = cand, sil = sil, k = kk)
    }
    if (is.null(best) || best$sil < min_sil) next
    sils <- c(sils, best$sil)
    sub <- best$km$cluster
    for (cl in seq_len(best$k)[-1]) {
      lab[idx[sub == cl]] <- next_id; todo[[length(todo) + 1]] <- idx[sub == cl]; next_id <- next_id + 1L
    }
    todo[[length(todo) + 1]] <- idx[sub == 1]
  }
  list(lab = lab, sils = sils)
}

player_classes <- NULL
class_selection_note <- "no classes were formed"

basis <- class_basis
if (basis %in% c("choice", "both") && !(patch_choice_ok && length(pc_person_fits) >= 3)) {
  message("Patch-choice profiles unavailable (", pc_note, ") -- grouping people on what they do once on a patch instead.")
  basis <- "action"
}
blocks <- list()

if (basis %in% c("choice", "both")) {
  blocks$choice <- do.call(rbind, lapply(pc_person_fits, function(f) choice_fingerprint(f$beta_std)))
}

if (basis %in% c("action", "both", "coefficients") && can_fit_model && length(player_fits) > 0) {
  if (basis %in% c("action", "both")) {
    action_levels <- as.character(sort(unique(model_data$actionID)))
    probes <- build_probes(model_data, predictor_cols_base, n_probes)
    fps <- map(player_fits, ~ tryCatch(fingerprint_one(.x, probes, action_levels),
                                       error = function(e) { message("Could not profile a person's model: ", conditionMessage(e)); NULL }))
    fps <- compact(fps)
    if (length(fps) > 0) { blocks$action <- do.call(rbind, fps); rownames(blocks$action) <- names(fps) }
  } else {
    player_coefs_long <- map2(player_fits, names(player_fits), extract_coefs_long) %>% compact() %>% bind_rows()
    if (nrow(player_coefs_long) > 0) {
      wide <- player_coefs_long %>%
        mutate(col_name = paste(outcome_level, feature, sep = "__")) %>%
        select(person_id, col_name, weight) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = col_name, values_from = weight)
      M <- wide %>% select(-person_id) %>% mutate(across(everything(), ~ replace(.x, is.na(.x), 0))) %>% as.matrix()
      rownames(M) <- wide$person_id
      blocks$coef <- M
    }
  }
}

if (length(blocks) > 0) {
  ids <- Reduce(intersect, lapply(blocks, rownames))
  Xcl <- do.call(cbind, compact(lapply(blocks, function(M) blk(M[ids, , drop = FALSE]))))
  if (length(ids) < 3 || is.null(Xcl) || ncol(Xcl) == 0) {
    message("Not enough people or variation to form classes (", length(ids), " person(s)) -- falling back to the pooled model.")
  } else {
    basis_desc <- c(choice = "which patches they go for", action = "what they do once on a patch",
                    both = "which patches they go for and what they do there", coefficients = "their raw per-person action weights")[[basis]]
    if (!is.null(n_classes_forced)) {
      k <- min(n_classes_forced, length(ids) - 1)
      set.seed(1); km <- kmeans(Xcl, centers = k, nstart = 20)
      lab <- km$cluster
      class_selection_note <- sprintf("the number of classes (%d) was set by hand (n_classes_forced); people grouped by %s", k, basis_desc)
    } else {
      rc <- recursive_classes(Xcl, class_split_min_sil, class_max_share, max_classes, min_class_size)
      lab <- rc$lab
      class_selection_note <- sprintf("%d class(es) by recursive splitting (a class holding over %.0f%% of people is split again when a split reaches mean silhouette %.2f%s); people grouped by %s",
                                      length(unique(lab)), 100 * class_max_share, class_split_min_sil,
                                      if (length(rc$sils) > 0) paste0("; accepted splits scored ", paste(sprintf("%.2f", rc$sils), collapse = ", ")) else "",
                                      basis_desc)
    }
    tb <- sort(table(lab), decreasing = TRUE)
    lab <- match(as.character(lab), names(tb))
    cat("Classes:", class_selection_note, "\n")
    player_classes <- tibble(person_id = ids, class = paste0("class_", lab))
  }
}

player_classes
```

## Step 8: refit one pooled model per discovered class

```{r fit-per-class}
class_fits <- list()

if (!is.null(player_classes)) {
  model_data_classed <- model_data %>% left_join(player_classes, by = "person_id")

  fit_one_class <- function(cid) {
    class_data <- model_data_classed %>% filter(class == cid)
    if (n_distinct(class_data$actionID) < 2) {
      message("Class ", cid, ": only one action type observed -- skipping.")
      return(NULL)
    }
    tryCatch(
      fit_mn(predictor_cols, class_data),
      error = function(e) {
        message("Class ", cid, ": failed to fit (", conditionMessage(e), ")")
        NULL
      }
    )
  }

  class_ids <- sort(unique(model_data_classed$class))
  class_fits <- set_names(map(class_ids, fit_one_class), class_ids)
  class_fits <- compact(class_fits)
  cat("Per-class models fit successfully for:", paste(names(class_fits), collapse = ", "), "\n")
}
```

Long format: `agent_type` (which class of player this row describes),
`decision_stage` (fixed at `"action_choice"` for everyone right now --
a placeholder column, not yet doing anything, since nothing in the
data so far has justified a genuine two-stage strategy-then-tactic
model), `outcome_option` (which action), `feature`, and `weight`.
Falls back to the single pooled model, tagged `agent_type = "pooled"`,

```{r export}
extract_export_rows <- function(model, agent_type) {
  cm <- coef(model)
  if (is.null(dim(cm))) {
    message(agent_type, ": exactly two action levels -- skipping in export (see Step 7's note).")
    return(NULL)
  }
  as.data.frame(cm) %>%
    tibble::as_tibble() %>%
    mutate(outcome_option = rownames(cm)) %>%
    pivot_longer(-outcome_option, names_to = "feature", values_to = "weight") %>%
    mutate(agent_type = agent_type, decision_stage = "action_choice") %>%
    select(agent_type, decision_stage, outcome_option, feature, weight)
}

  write_csv(export_rows, "agent_behavior_weights.csv")

  # The ABM interpreter needs to know which actionID was the reference/
  # baseline category, since a multinomial logit's reference level has no
  # row in coef() at all -- its score is implicitly 0, everything else is
  # a log-odds relative to it. Writing it out explicitly here rather than
  # making the NetLogo side infer it.
  write_csv(tibble(reference_actionID = reference_action), "agent_behavior_reference.csv")
}
```

```{r export-sessionlist-abm}
# Wire the ABM run's sessionList.csv automatically: same columns as the
# game's own sessionList.csv, plus the three pointers to this notebook's
# own outputs. Any other ABM-specific tuning (agent counts, a bigger
# world, etc.) is still a manual edit on top of the file this writes --
# only the error-prone pointer wiring is automated here.
if (file.exists("sessionList.csv") && nrow(export_rows) > 0) {
  session_list <- read_csv("sessionList.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
  session_list$behaviorListFileName     <- "agent_behavior_weights.csv"
  session_list$referenceActionFileName  <- "agent_behavior_reference.csv"
  session_list$outcomePlotListFileName  <- "outcomePlotList.csv"
  # v2: tells the ABM which settings its fitted behavior responds to (and their fitted ranges)
  if (file.exists("agent_behavior_treatment_ranges.csv")) {
    session_list$treatmentRangeFileName <- "agent_behavior_treatment_ranges.csv"
  }
  # na = "" (not readr's default "NA") -- sessionList.csv can legitimately
  # leave an optional column blank (e.g. patch_color_property, meaning "no
  # property-driven shading, use the default color"). read_csv() reads
  # that blank cell as R's NA; write_csv()'s default na="NA" would then
  # serialize it back out as the literal 3-character string "NA", not an
  # empty cell. The ABM generator's generic CSV-driven config loader has
  # no way to tell "the text NA" apart from a real value, so it tries to
  # runresult "NA" as a NetLogo expression and crashes ("Nothing named NA
  # has been defined") the moment that column is used -- confirmed live,
  # Cut the Creep's patch_color_property. na="" keeps a blank cell blank
  # all the way through the round-trip, matching what a human-authored
  # sessionList.csv would have.
  write_csv(session_list, "sessionList_ABM.csv", na = "")
  cat("Wrote sessionList_ABM.csv (", nrow(session_list), "row(s), from sessionList.csv plus the three output pointers).\n")
} else if (!file.exists("sessionList.csv")) {
  message("No sessionList.csv in the working directory -- skipped writing sessionList_ABM.csv. ",
          "Copy the game's sessionList.csv here (or point setwd() at the game folder) and re-run this chunk.")
}
```

## Step 10: hand the results to the ABM, including its treatment widgets

With `promote_to_abm <- TRUE` (Settings, top of the notebook) this step copies
the weights, reference, session list and treatment files into the ABM folder
and edits the ABM file's interface so that every treatment the fitted behavior
responds to has a widget:

- a number -> a **slider** (fitted range widened by 50% each side, so users can try values outside the data; the ABM warns when they do),
- TRUE/FALSE -> a **switch**,
- a few named options -> a **chooser**.

Widgets are named `sl_<setting>`. In the ABM, "Initialize Session" fills them from the chosen session, and "Setup" applies them. Set `promote_to_abm <- FALSE` to leave the ABM folder untouched. The ABM file is backed up once as `.bak`. Run this step again after any re-knit; it replaces earlier widgets.

```{r promote-to-abm}
fmt_num <- function(x) format(round(x, 10), scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE)
xml_attr <- function(x) gsub("\"", "&quot;", gsub(">", "&gt;", gsub("<", "&lt;", gsub("&", "&amp;", x))))

make_widget_specs <- function(td, srow) {
  specs <- list()
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(td))) {
    v <- td$variable[i]; ty <- td$type[i]
    if (!grepl("^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$", v)) { message(v, ": name not usable as a widget variable -- skipped."); next }
    raw <- if (!is.null(srow) && v %in% names(srow)) srow[[v]][1] else NA
    if (ty == "logical") {
      specs[[length(specs) + 1]] <- list(v = v, kind = "switch", on = isTRUE(as.logical(raw)))
    } else if (ty == "categorical") {
      lv <- strsplit(td$levels[i], ";", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
      if (length(lv) == 0) { message(v, ": no levels recorded -- skipped."); next }
      cur <- match(as.character(raw), lv) - 1
      specs[[length(specs) + 1]] <- list(v = v, kind = "chooser", levels = lv, cur = if (is.na(cur)) 0 else cur)
    } else {
      lo <- td$min_value[i]; hi <- td$max_value[i]; span <- hi - lo
      smin <- lo - 0.5 * span; smax <- hi + 0.5 * span
      if (lo >= 0) smin <- max(0, smin)
      integer <- isTRUE(td$integer_valued[i])
      step <- if (integer) 1 else if (smax > smin) 10^floor(log10((smax - smin) / 100)) else 0.01
      if (integer) { smin <- floor(smin); smax <- ceiling(smax) }
      d <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(raw)); if (is.na(d)) d <- (lo + hi) / 2
      specs[[length(specs) + 1]] <- list(v = v, kind = "slider", lo = smin, hi = smax,
                                         d = min(max(d, smin), smax), step = step)
    }
  }
  specs
}

widget_xml <- function(sp, y) {
  v <- xml_attr(sp$v)
  if (sp$kind == "slider") {
    sprintf('<slider x="10" y="%d" width="320" height="34" min="%s" max="%s" default="%s" step="%s" direction="Horizontal" display="sl_%s" variable="sl_%s"></slider>',
            y, fmt_num(sp$lo), fmt_num(sp$hi), fmt_num(sp$d), fmt_num(sp$step), v, v)
  } else if (sp$kind == "switch") {
    sprintf('<switch x="10" y="%d" width="320" height="34" display="sl_%s" variable="sl_%s" on="%s"></switch>',
            y, v, v, if (sp$on) "true" else "false")
  } else {
    ch <- paste0('<choice type="string" value="', xml_attr(sp$levels), '"></choice>', collapse = "")
    sprintf('<chooser x="10" y="%d" width="320" height="40" display="sl_%s" variable="sl_%s" current="%d">%s</chooser>',
            y, v, v, as.integer(sp$cur), ch)
  }
}

# Move every left-column (x = 10) widget whose y is at least y_from by dy.
shift_y <- function(block, y_from, dy) {
  m <- gregexpr('<[a-z]+ [^>]*?x="10" [^>]*?y="[0-9]+"', block, perl = TRUE)
  tags <- regmatches(block, m)[[1]]
  if (length(tags) == 0) return(block)
  moved <- vapply(tags, function(t) {
    y <- as.integer(sub('.*y="([0-9]+)"$', "\\1", t))
    if (y >= y_from) sub('y="[0-9]+"$', sprintf('y="%d"', y + dy), t) else t
  }, character(1), USE.NAMES = FALSE)
  regmatches(block, m)[[1]] <- moved
  block
}

update_abm_interface <- function(nl_path, specs) {
  H <- 44
  txt <- read_file(nl_path)
  bak <- paste0(nl_path, ".bak")
  if (!file.exists(bak)) file.copy(nl_path, bak)
  # drop widgets from an earlier run (the layout is re-normalised below)
  txt <- gsub('\n    <(slider|switch|chooser) [^\n]*variable="sl_[^"]*"[^\n]*</\\1>', "", txt, perl = TRUE)
  w <- regexpr("(?s)<widgets>.*?</widgets>", txt, perl = TRUE)
  if (w < 0) stop("No <widgets> section found in ", nl_path)
  w_len <- attr(w, "match.length")
  block <- substr(txt, w + nchar("<widgets>"), w + w_len - nchar("</widgets>") - 1)
  init_y  <- regmatches(block, regexec('<button x="10"[^>]*?y="([0-9]+)"[^>]*?display="2\\. Initialize Session"', block, perl = TRUE))[[1]]
  setup_y <- regmatches(block, regexec('<button x="10"[^>]*?y="([0-9]+)"[^>]*?display="3\\. Setup"', block, perl = TRUE))[[1]]
  if (length(init_y) < 2 || length(setup_y) < 2) stop("Could not find the Initialize Session / Setup buttons in the ABM interface.")
  y_init <- as.integer(init_y[2]); y_setup <- as.integer(setup_y[2])
  y0 <- y_init + 43                                   # where Setup sits with no treatment widgets
  if (y_setup != y0) block <- shift_y(block, y_setup, y0 - y_setup)
  if (length(specs) > 0) block <- shift_y(block, y0, H * length(specs))
  new <- paste0(vapply(seq_along(specs), function(k) paste0("\n    ", widget_xml(specs[[k]], y0 + H * (k - 1))), character(1)), collapse = "")
  b <- regexpr('\n[ \t]*<button x="10"[^>]*?display="3\\. Setup"', block, perl = TRUE)
  block <- paste0(substr(block, 1, b - 1), new, substr(block, b, nchar(block)))
  txt <- paste0(substr(txt, 1, w - 1), "<widgets>", block, "</widgets>", substr(txt, w + w_len, nchar(txt)))
  write_file(txt, nl_path)
  invisible(length(specs))
}

if (promote_to_abm && nrow(export_rows) > 0) {
  if (!dir.exists(abm_dir)) {
    message("promote_to_abm: folder '", abm_dir, "' not found (relative to ", getwd(),
            ") -- nothing copied. Edit abm_dir in Settings, or copy the files by hand.")
  } else {
    to_copy <- c("agent_behavior_weights.csv", "agent_behavior_reference.csv", "sessionList_ABM.csv",
                 "agent_behavior_treatment_ranges.csv", "treatment_report.csv",
                 "agent_class_shares.csv", "person_classes.csv", "agent_patch_choice_weights.csv", "choice_treatment_report.csv")
    for (f in to_copy) if (file.exists(f)) file.copy(f, file.path(abm_dir, f), overwrite = TRUE)
    if (!file.exists("agent_behavior_treatment_ranges.csv") &&
        file.exists(file.path(abm_dir, "agent_behavior_treatment_ranges.csv"))) {
      file.remove(file.path(abm_dir, "agent_behavior_treatment_ranges.csv"))
    }
    cat("Copied to", abm_dir, ":", paste(to_copy[file.exists(to_copy)], collapse = ", "), "\n")

    nl_path <- file.path(abm_dir, "tapSquares_ABM_generator.nlogox")
    if (!file.exists(nl_path)) {
      message("No tapSquares_ABM_generator.nlogox in ", abm_dir, " -- treatment widgets not added.")
    } else {
      td_used <- treatment_diag %>% filter(used | used_choice)
      srow <- if (exists("session_list")) session_list[1, , drop = FALSE] else NULL
      specs <- make_widget_specs(td_used, srow)
      update_abm_interface(nl_path, specs)
      cat("ABM interface now has", length(specs), "treatment widget(s):",
          if (length(specs) == 0) "(none)" else paste0(map_chr(specs, "v"), " [", map_chr(specs, "kind"), "]", collapse = ", "), "\n")
    }
  }
} else if (!promote_to_abm) {
  message("promote_to_abm is FALSE -- the ABM folder was not touched.")
}
```

## Step 11: a PDF guide to the dataset and the fitted model

With `make_pdf_report <- TRUE` this writes `dataset_guide.pdf` next to the
notebook (no LaTeX needed): what data went in, how many classes of player
were found, what each class does, the loadings behind it, which treatments
were and were not usable, who is in which class, and a list of cautions the
notebook can detect for itself. Read the cautions page before the pictures.

```{r pdf-guide}
if (make_pdf_report) tryCatch({
  # ---- labels ----
  action_labels <- c("-99" = "do nothing")
  if (file.exists("actionList.csv")) {
    al <- read_csv("actionList.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
    if (all(c("actionID", "imageName") %in% names(al))) {
      action_labels <- c(action_labels, setNames(paste0(al$actionID, " ", al$imageName), as.character(al$actionID)))
    }
  }
  lab_action <- function(a) { a <- as.character(a); unname(ifelse(a %in% names(action_labels), action_labels[a], a)) }
  clean_feature <- function(f) gsub("`", "", f)

  md <- model_data %>% mutate(action_lab = lab_action(actionID))
  if (!is.null(player_classes)) md <- md %>% left_join(player_classes, by = "person_id") else md$class <- NA_character_
  md <- md %>% mutate(class = coalesce(class, if (is.null(player_classes)) "all persons" else "unclassified"))

  have_loadings <- exists("export_rows") && nrow(export_rows) > 0
  weights_all <- if (have_loadings) export_rows %>%
    mutate(feature = clean_feature(feature), action = lab_action(outcome_option)) else NULL
  n_classes <- if (is.null(player_classes)) 0 else n_distinct(player_classes$class)

  text_page <- function(title, lines, family = "sans", size = 3.6, width = 105) {
    txt <- paste(unlist(lapply(lines, function(l) c(strwrap(l, width = width), ""))), collapse = "\n")
    ggplot() +
      annotate("text", x = 0, y = 1, label = txt, hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = size, lineheight = 1.1, family = family) +
      xlim(0, 1) + ylim(0, 1) + labs(title = title) + theme_void() +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16), plot.margin = margin(20, 30, 20, 30))
  }

  # ---- cautions the notebook can detect ----
  cautions <- character(0)
  n_sess_all <- n_distinct(model_data$session_id)
  if (n_sess_all < min_sessions_total) cautions <- c(cautions, sprintf(
    "Only %d session(s) (treatment checks want at least %d): treatment effects cannot be judged, and everything else rests on few situations.", n_sess_all, min_sessions_total))
  if (n_classes > 0) {
    cs <- player_classes %>% count(class)
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(cs))) if (cs$n[i] < 3) cautions <- c(cautions, sprintf(
      "Class %s contains only %d person(s). A group that small is an outlier, not a type of player.", cs$class[i], cs$n[i]))
  } else cautions <- c(cautions, "No classes were formed (too few people with enough decisions, or too little variation); the exported behavior is one pooled model.")
  if (have_loadings) {
    big <- sum(abs(export_rows$weight) > 20, na.rm = TRUE)
    if (big > 0) cautions <- c(cautions, sprintf(
      "%d of %d fitted weights exceed 20 in size. That usually means a few choices were predicted perfectly from too little data; those weights are not interpretable and can make ABM agents behave extremely.", big, nrow(export_rows)))
  }
  if (exists("no_roster") && nrow(no_roster) > 0) cautions <- c(cautions, sprintf(
    "%d player(s) had no recorded ID, so each counts as a separate person and cannot be linked across sessions.", nrow(no_roster)))
  per_person_n <- model_data %>% count(person_id)
  few <- sum(per_person_n$n < min_decisions_per_person)
  if (few > 0) cautions <- c(cautions, sprintf(
    "%d of %d people have fewer than %d recorded decisions and were left out of the per-person fits and clustering.", few, nrow(per_person_n), min_decisions_per_person))
  if (use_patch_choice && !patch_choice_ok) cautions <- c(cautions, paste0(
    "Where people act could not be modeled (", pc_note, "), so classes cannot reflect which patches people choose."))
  if (n_classes > 0) cautions <- c(cautions, paste0("How the classes were formed: ", class_selection_note,
    ". Classes come from clustering noisy per-person weights, so treat them as a description of this sample."))
  if (length(cautions) == 0) cautions <- "None detected."

  # ---- pages ----
  pages <- list()

  pages$summary <- function() {
    ts <- if (length(treatments_used) == 0) "none" else paste(treatments_used, collapse = ", ")
    n_cand <- if (exists("treatment_diag")) nrow(treatment_diag) else 0
    cls <- if (n_classes == 0) "none (pooled model)" else paste(
      sprintf("%s: %d person(s)", (player_classes %>% count(class))$class, (player_classes %>% count(class))$n), collapse = "; ")
    text_page("Dataset guide: summary", c(
      sprintf("Sessions: %d.  People (distinct IDs): %d, of whom %d appear in more than one session.  Recorded decisions: %d.",
              n_sess_all, n_distinct(model_data$person_id), sum(person_summary$n_sessions > 1), nrow(model_data)),
      sprintf("Players per session: %s.  Rounds: up to %s.", paste(range((person_map %>% count(session_id))$n), collapse = " to "), max(model_data$round, na.rm = TRUE)),
      sprintf("Choices modeled: %s.  Reference choice (all weights are log-odds relative to it): %s.",
              paste(lab_action(sort(unique(model_data$actionID))), collapse = ", "), lab_action(reference_action)),
      sprintf("Classes of player found: %d.  %s", n_classes, cls),
      sprintf("Session settings examined as possible treatments: %d.  Used as predictors: %s.", n_cand, ts),
      if (patch_choice_ok) paste0("Patch-choice model: ", pc_note, ". Treatments: ", choice_treatment_note, ".") else "Patch-choice model: not run.",
      "CAUTIONS (detected automatically):", paste("-", cautions)), size = 3.8)
  }

  pages$how_to <- function() text_page("How to read this guide", c(
    "A WEIGHT is a coefficient from a multinomial logit: how much a feature raises (positive) or lowers (negative) the log-odds of a choice, relative to the reference choice. A weight of 0.7 roughly doubles the odds; -0.7 roughly halves them, other things equal.",
    "A CLASS is a group of people whose individual models would choose alike in the same circumstances. By default (class_basis = 'choice') that means which patches they go for next, or whether they stop (the patch-choice model, Step 6b); the action they take there is described separately. A class describes how people respond to the board and game state in this data; it is not a personality type. WHEN a person acts is invisible unless round/phase were switched on in variableRoles.csv.",
    "PATCH-CHOICE weights (the 'where' heat map) are per standard deviation of each feature: blue = patches with more of it are more likely to be picked next, red = less likely. Rows named stop and stop_k describe the tendency to end the turn, and how it grows with the number of picks already made. cropOwner_mine (or similar) means the patch holds the player's own crop; avail_N means action N is possible there. A name like p_fine:protected? is a TREATMENT crossing: how a session setting changes the appeal of that kind of patch (negative: patches with it become less likely to be picked as the setting rises).",
    "Heat maps: rows are features, columns are choices, colour shows the weight (clipped for readability; the printed number is the true value). Red lowers the chance of that choice, blue raises it.",
    "TREATMENTS are session-level settings (e.g. fine probability, cost of protecting). A treatment is USED only if the data vary enough in it, it cannot be confused with another setting, and it improves prediction on whole sessions it was not fitted on. 'Not used' means this data cannot show an effect, not that there is none.",
    "Features named like water?TRUE are yes/no state; names ending in a level (e.g. ownedBy1) are categories compared with the left-out level.",
    "With few sessions or few people per class, treat every picture as a description of this sample, not a finding about farmers in general."), size = 3.8)

  pages$actions <- function() {
    d <- md %>% count(action_lab) %>% mutate(share = n / sum(n))
    ggplot(d, aes(reorder(action_lab, n), n)) + geom_col(fill = "#4a7ab5") +
      geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%d (%.0f%%)", n, 100 * share)), hjust = -0.1, size = 3.5) +
      coord_flip() + scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.2))) +
      labs(title = "What people chose", subtitle = "Recorded decisions by choice, all sessions", x = NULL, y = "decisions") + theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
  }

  pages$people <- function() {
    d <- md %>% count(person_id, class) %>% arrange(desc(n))
    d$person_id <- factor(d$person_id, levels = rev(d$person_id))
    ggplot(d, aes(person_id, n, fill = class)) + geom_col() + coord_flip() +
      geom_hline(yintercept = min_decisions_per_person, linetype = "dashed") +
      labs(title = "How much data each person contributes", subtitle = sprintf("Dashed line = minimum (%d) for an individual fit", min_decisions_per_person),
           x = NULL, y = "decisions", fill = "class") + theme_minimal(base_size = 10)
  }

  pages$class_mix <- function() {
    d <- md %>% count(class, action_lab) %>% group_by(class) %>% mutate(share = n / sum(n)) %>% ungroup()
    np <- md %>% distinct(class, person_id) %>% count(class, name = "persons")
    d <- d %>% left_join(np, by = "class") %>% mutate(class_lab = sprintf("%s\n(%d people)", class, persons))
    ggplot(d, aes(class_lab, share, fill = action_lab)) + geom_col() +
      geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(share > 0.04, sprintf("%.0f%%", 100 * share), "")), position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), size = 3.3) +
      scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
      labs(title = "What each class does", subtitle = "Share of the class's decisions by choice", x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "choice") + theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
  }

  pages$choice_loadings <- function() {
    d <- bind_rows(imap(c(class_choice_fits, list(pooled = pooled_choice_fit)),
                        function(f, nm) tibble(agent_type = nm, feature = pc_fit$colnames, w = f$beta_std)))
    clipv <- 3
    d <- d %>% mutate(w_clip = pmax(pmin(w, clipv), -clipv))
    ord <- d %>% filter(agent_type == "pooled") %>% arrange(desc(abs(w))) %>% pull(feature)
    d$feature <- factor(d$feature, levels = rev(ord))
    d$agent_type <- factor(d$agent_type, levels = c(sort(setdiff(unique(d$agent_type), "pooled")), "pooled"))
    ggplot(d, aes(agent_type, feature, fill = w_clip)) + geom_tile(color = "white") +
      geom_text(aes(label = round(w, 1)), size = 2.8) +
      scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#b2182b", mid = "white", high = "#2166ac", limits = c(-clipv, clipv), name = "weight\n(clipped)") +
      labs(title = "Where each class acts: patch-choice weights",
           subtitle = "Per standard deviation of each feature. Blue = more likely to be picked next; red = less likely. 'stop' = tendency to end the turn.",
           x = NULL, y = NULL) + theme_minimal(base_size = 10)
  }

  loading_page <- function(at) function() {
    d <- weights_all %>% filter(agent_type == at)
    top <- d %>% group_by(feature) %>% summarise(m = max(abs(weight)), .groups = "drop") %>% arrange(desc(m)) %>% slice_head(n = 30) %>% pull(feature)
    d <- d %>% filter(feature %in% top) %>%
      mutate(feature = factor(feature, levels = rev(top)), w_clip = pmax(pmin(weight, loading_clip), -loading_clip))
    npers <- if (n_classes > 0) sum(player_classes$class == at) else NA
    ggplot(d, aes(action, feature, fill = w_clip)) + geom_tile(color = "white") +
      geom_text(aes(label = round(weight, 1)), size = 2.7) +
      scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#b2182b", mid = "white", high = "#2166ac", limits = c(-loading_clip, loading_clip), name = "weight\n(clipped)") +
      labs(title = sprintf("Loadings: %s", at),
           subtitle = sprintf("%s. Top %d features by largest weight; reference choice = %s",
                              if (is.na(npers)) "pooled model" else sprintf("%d people", npers), length(top), lab_action(reference_action)),
           x = "choice", y = NULL) + theme_minimal(base_size = 10)
  }

  pages$differences <- function() {
    sp <- weights_all %>% group_by(feature, action) %>%
      summarise(rng = max(weight) - min(weight), .groups = "drop") %>% arrange(desc(rng)) %>% slice_head(n = 20)
    d <- weights_all %>% inner_join(sp, by = c("feature", "action")) %>% mutate(pair = paste0(action, "  |  ", feature))
    d$pair <- factor(d$pair, levels = rev(unique(d$pair[order(-d$rng)])))
    ggplot(d, aes(weight, pair, color = agent_type)) + geom_point(size = 3) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted") +
      labs(title = "What separates the classes", subtitle = "The 20 (choice | feature) pairs whose weights differ most between classes",
           x = "weight", y = NULL, color = "class") + theme_minimal(base_size = 10)
  }

  pages$treat_overview <- function() {
    td <- treatment_diag
    const <- td %>% filter(grepl("^constant", notes) | n_distinct == 1)
    d <- td %>% filter(!(variable %in% const$variable)) %>% mutate(cv_plot = ifelse(is.na(cv_gain), 0, cv_gain))
    sub <- sprintf("%d setting(s) did not vary across sessions and are not shown. Gain = improvement in predicting held-out sessions (needs > %g to be used).", nrow(const), cv_min_gain)
    if (nrow(d) == 0) return(text_page("Treatments", c("No session setting varied across the sessions in this data, so no treatment could be examined.", sub)))
    ggplot(d, aes(reorder(variable, cv_plot), cv_plot, fill = overall)) + geom_col() +
      geom_hline(yintercept = cv_min_gain, linetype = "dashed") +
      geom_text(aes(label = paste0(source, "; ", variation_verdict)), hjust = 0, size = 3, y = 0, nudge_y = max(d$cv_plot, cv_min_gain) * 0.02) +
      coord_flip() + labs(title = "Treatments: what could be examined", subtitle = sub, x = NULL, y = "held-out gain per decision", fill = NULL) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 11) + theme(legend.position = "bottom")
  }

  pages$treat_effects <- function() {
    tf <- weights_all %>% filter(Reduce(`|`, lapply(treatments_used, function(tv) startsWith(feature, tv))))
    ggplot(tf, aes(weight, action, color = agent_type)) + geom_point(size = 3) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted") + facet_wrap(~ feature, scales = "free_x") +
      labs(title = "Treatment effects in the fitted behavior", subtitle = "Weight of each used treatment, per choice and class (log-odds vs the reference choice)",
           x = "weight", y = NULL, color = "class") + theme_minimal(base_size = 11)
  }

  roster_pages <- function() {
    r <- person_summary %>% left_join(per_person_n, by = "person_id") %>%
      left_join(if (is.null(player_classes)) tibble(person_id = character(), class = character()) else player_classes, by = "person_id") %>%
      mutate(class = coalesce(class, "-")) %>% arrange(class, person_id)
    r <- r %>% transmute(person = person_id, sessions = n_sessions, decisions = n, class = class)
    chunks <- split(r, ceiling(seq_len(nrow(r)) / 40))
    lapply(seq_along(chunks), function(i) function() {
      tab <- capture.output(print(as.data.frame(chunks[[i]]), row.names = FALSE, right = FALSE))
      text_page(sprintf("Who is in which class (%d of %d)", i, length(chunks)), tab, family = "mono", size = 3.4, width = 120)
    })
  }

  page_list <- list(pages$summary, pages$how_to, pages$actions, pages$people)
  if (n_classes > 0) page_list <- c(page_list, list(pages$class_mix))
  if (patch_choice_ok) page_list <- c(page_list, list(pages$choice_loadings))
  if (have_loadings) page_list <- c(page_list, lapply(sort(unique(weights_all$agent_type)), loading_page))
  if (have_loadings && n_distinct(weights_all$agent_type) >= 2) page_list <- c(page_list, list(pages$differences))
  if (exists("treatment_diag") && nrow(treatment_diag) > 0) page_list <- c(page_list, list(pages$treat_overview))
  if (have_loadings && length(treatments_used) > 0) page_list <- c(page_list, list(pages$treat_effects))
  page_list <- c(page_list, roster_pages())

  pdf(report_file, width = 11, height = 8.5)
  n_ok <- 0
  for (pg in page_list) {
    ok <- tryCatch({ print(pg()); TRUE }, error = function(e) { message("Guide page skipped: ", conditionMessage(e)); FALSE })
    n_ok <- n_ok + ok
  }
  dev.off()
  cat("Wrote", report_file, "with", n_ok, "of", length(page_list), "page(s).\n")
}, error = function(e) message("PDF guide failed (the rest of the notebook is unaffected): ", conditionMessage(e)))
```

## Notes / what this notebook deliberately doesn't do yet

- **Own-patch state only.** Predictors come only from the patch itself
  (the action model) or from each candidate patch separately (the
  patch-choice model), not from the fuller board-wide / multi-scale
  feature set discussed earlier. Treatments enter only the action model
  as additive effects, not the patch-choice model (a session-wide setting
  cancels out of a choice among patches unless it is crossed with a
  patch feature).
- **Patch-choice treatment crossings (names like `p_fine:protected?`)** are products of a session setting and a patch feature; the ABM does not evaluate `a:b` names yet.
- **The ABM does not use the patch-choice weights yet.** It still picks
  where to act by scoring every action on every patch against "do
  nothing". `agent_patch_choice_weights.csv` is written for the next step.
- **No visibility-treatment handling** yet.
- **Person identity is whatever was typed at entry.** The same string in
  two sessions is taken to be the same person; typos, nicknames or two
  people sharing a name will blur individuals. Logs without PLAYER lines
  give every player a session-local placeholder ID.
- **Treatments are additive main effects.** No interactions with state,
  and no session-level random effects. Treatment weights from a small or
  narrow pool are weak evidence; Step 5a reports whether the pool could
  show an effect at all, not that the effect is real.
- **Mean-of-list settings (e.g. `pRain_mean`) are diagnosed but not used**:
  the ABM cannot evaluate those names.
- **Assumes one consistent game per batch of files** (same
  `patchPropertyList` schema across sessions).
- **The per-player-then-cluster approach is an approximation.** A real
  latent-class discrete choice model (`gmnl`, `model = "lc"`) is the
  more rigorous version, worth moving to once there's enough data
  across enough sessions/players to make joint EM estimation pay off
  over this simpler two-step version.
- **The two-stage `decision_stage` column is a placeholder.** Nothing
  currently populates more than one stage.
- **Exactly two available actions is a rough edge** for `coef()`'s
  output shape, handled by skipping (with a message) rather than
  guessing at a fix, in the per-player, clustering, and export steps.
- **Categorical counter/ownership levels unseen at prediction time**
  are this notebook's problem only insofar as they can't be fit on
  data that doesn't contain them. Making the *ABM generator* degrade
  gracefully (rather than erroring) when it encounters an unseen
  categorical level at runtime is separate NetLogo-side work, tracked
  alongside this file, not solved here.
